# Sources

This folder contains the provenance records for the source PDF documents ingested into the wiki. Each page serves as a metadata and navigation hub for a specific annual report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), detailing the file hash, page count, ingestion date, and providing direct links to every extracted document page chunk. These records ensure that every claim and entity in the wiki can be traced back to its exact location in the original 2023 and 2024 AFDK reports.

## Pages

- [[afdk-2023|Source: AFDK_2023.pdf]] — Provenance record and page index for the 121-page 2023 AFDK annual report, linking to all 25 extracted document chunks.
- [[afdk-2024|Source: AFDK_2024.pdf]] — Provenance record and page index for the 113-page 2024 AFDK annual report, linking to all 23 extracted document chunks.
